description: Consolidate the four per-artifact core/artifact-exists plan checks in the mohist/local profile into a single mohist/openspec-artifacts check that gates all four plan artifacts (proposal.md, specs/, design.md, tasks.json), retiring the 'specs is optional' behavior so both built-in profiles gate plan artifacts the same way.

tasks.title: Extend openspecArtifactsAction to require the specs/ directory
tasks.description: Append a `{ path: join(changeDir, "specs"), kind: "directory" }` entry to the `required` array in `openspecArtifactsAction` (packages/runner/src/actions/openspec.ts), so the action gates all four plan artifacts and treats a missing or wrong-kind `specs/` as missing. Update packages/runner/tests/openspec.spec.ts so the former 'specs is optional' case becomes a required-artifact failure case asserting `present: false`, `status: failure`, and the specs path in both `output.missing` and the failure message; keep the all-present case (which already creates specs/) consistent with the new four-entry set, and add a wrong-kind case asserting that a required directory present as a file (or a required file present as a directory) is reported in output.missing.
acceptanceCriteria: openspecArtifactsAction.required lists exactly four entries: proposal.md (file), specs/ (directory), design.md (file), tasks.json (file).
When specs/ is absent under changeDir, the action returns status: failure with present: false and the resolved specs/ path in output.missing.
When specs/ exists as the wrong kind (a file instead of a directory), isPresentOfKind treats it as missing and the path appears in output.missing.
When all four artifacts are present and correctly kinded, the action returns status: success with present: true and missing: [].
The failure message contains every path listed in output.missing (single and multiple-missing cases).
`npm test -w packages/runner` (openspec spec) passes with no skipped specs.
tasks.output: Modified packages/runner/src/actions/openspec.ts and packages/runner/tests/openspec.spec.ts; runner typecheck + openspec spec green.
tasks.notes: Runner deploys first per design migration plan. This tightens the github-pr profile too, but github-pr's plan stage always produces specs/ via its dedicated specs task, so in-flight runs are unaffected. core/artifact-exists stays registered (D4) — do not remove it.

tasks.title: Consolidate mohist/local plan-stage artifact checks into one plan-artifacts check
tasks.description: In packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/mohist-local.workflow.yaml, remove the four core/artifact-exists checks (proposal-complete, specs-complete, design-complete, tasks-valid) from the plan stage and replace them with a single check named plan-artifacts that `uses: mohist/openspec-artifacts` with `changeDir: ${{ openspecChangeDir }}`, mirroring mohist-github-pr.workflow.yaml. Keep self-review-passed and health as distinct checks, leaving exactly three plan-stage checks. Add a local-profile server spec counterpart to GithubPrWorkflowDefinition_PlanStage_HasSingleOpenspecArtifactsCheck (MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs.cs:253) asserting the single plan-artifacts check and absence of the four old names, and update the VariableScopeSpecs.cs:251-254 fixture that still models the four core/artifact-exists checks to the single consolidated check.
acceptanceCriteria: mohist-local.workflow.yaml plan stage checks contain exactly one artifact gate with name: plan-artifacts and uses: mohist/openspec-artifacts, bound changeDir: ${{ openspecChangeDir }}.
mohist-local.workflow.yaml plan stage checks no longer include proposal-complete, specs-complete, design-complete, or tasks-valid.

mohist-local.workflow.yaml plan stage retains self-review-passed (core/marker over self-review.md) and health (core/script running git diff --check) as distinct entries, for exactly three checks total.
A new local-profile server spec asserts the single plan-artifacts entry, the absence of the four per-artifact names, and that changeDir binds to ${{ openspecChangeDir }}.
VariableScopeSpecs.cs fixture models the single mohist/openspec-artifacts plan-artifacts check instead of the four core/artifact-exists dispatches.
`npm test` at root (server specs + VariableScopeSpecs) passes.
tasks.output: Modified mohist-local.workflow.yaml, new/updated local-profile server spec in MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfileSpecs.cs, and updated VariableScopeSpecs.cs; root npm test green.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 so the dispatched mohist/openspec-artifacts action actually gates specs/, preserving local's former specs-complete gate. self-review-passed and health must not be folded into plan-artifacts (D3).

tasks.title: Update workflow-profile docs to the consolidated plan-artifacts check
tasks.description: Update the documentation surfaces that still describe the four per-artifact checks or the 'specs is optional' behavior: design/workflow/builtin-workflows/local.md (plan checks reduced from six to three: plan-artifacts, self-review-passed, health), design/workflow/builtin-workflows/github-pr.md (retire the stale 'specs/ optional' note at github-pr.md:124-125 — specs/ is now required by mohist/openspec-artifacts), and the docs/workflow-profiles.md example block that lists proposal-complete/specs-complete/design-complete/tasks-valid so it reflects the single plan-artifacts check. Documentation uses product//domain language only in docs/ and may use technical language in design/. No code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: design/workflow/builtin-workflows/local.md describes the plan stage as gating artifacts through a single mohist/openspec-artifacts plan-artifacts check alongside self-review-passed and health, with no reference to the four per-artifact core/artifact-exists dispatches.
design/workflow/builtin-workflows/github-pr.md no longer states specs/ is optional; it documents specs/ as a required plan artifact gated by mohist/openspec-artifacts.

docs/workflow-profiles.md example block for the local plan stage shows the consolidated plan-artifacts check instead of proposal-complete/specs-complete/design-complete/tasks-valid, and uses only product/domain language (no source paths, handler, or registry references).
No other doc surface still references the retired four-check local plan shape as current behavior.
Docs-only change: no code, config, or test files modified.
tasks.notes: Documents the final consolidated shape implemented by T-001 (action covers specs/) and T-002 (local YAML uses one plan-artifacts check). Respect the docs/ vs design/ language boundary from AGENTS.md.
